_comment: Throne & Liberty raids a run can be posted for. `modes` are in order of difficulty, easiest first: a post takes its colour from the hardest mode in its plan. `aliases` are extra words /raid post accepts for a mode ("nm 1"). `roles` is the slot count per role; anyone past it goes to the bench. A run copies `roles` when it is posted, so changing a cap here never reshuffles a run already filling. Keys are stored on raid_runs, so add new ones rather than renaming.
